content:
If you are new to the concept of decision modeling and/or decisionAccelerator, or just need a refresher, we suggest you watch the following tutorials in order.

  • Introduction to Decision Modeling

  • 3 Decision Types

  • Introduction to Decision Analysis

  • decisionAccelerator Methodology Overview

  • decisionAccelerator Model

  • decisionAccelerator Pairwise Analysis

  • decisionAccelerator Constraints

  • Mapping a Decision using decisionAccelerator
